This week's post

Facebook · Tuesday

Three things we check before we sign off any boiler install. Not because anyone asks, but because the one time you skip them is the time you get a call at 6am on a Sunday.

Flue clearance. Gas pressure under load. And we run it for twenty minutes and come back to it, because a boiler that works for two minutes works for two minutes.

If your last install was signed off in under an hour, ask which of those they did.

Booking in an emergency call-out

6 steps

1

Answer, take the address and the postcode before anything else.

2

Ask if they can smell gas. If yes, tell them to open windows and turn it off at the meter, then call 0800 111 999.

3

Quote the call-out fee out loud and get a yes before you book it in.

4

Put it in the diary. [ASSUMED: Google Calendar, because your site links one. Check this.]
